title: Roguelike RTS in ~2 weeks working with Claude — procedural pixel art, 200+ bonuses, browser demo
author: Ouchini
selftext:
Finally got around to building a little game I’d had in mind, and after a couple of weeks the demo is online.

It’s a roguelike RTS, made entirely in HTML, runs right in your browser. Lots of unlockable bonuses (some serious, some pretty silly), an endless cyclic campaign, and a bunch of stuff to unlock. 

I built the whole thing working with Claude — I handle the design and balancing, it handles the code.

Honestly there’s still a lot to improve and I’m not totally sold on the graphics yet, but I wanted to get it out there and see what people think.

If you feel like giving it a look, you’d really help me out by leaving a comment — what you liked, what you’d change, any ideas at all. I read everything.

Thanks

[Kingdoms at War](https://kawars.itch.io/kingdoms-at-war)
